notes.title: Horny Holiday 3.3 Beta Edition Now Available
notes.content:
Hey there, it's showtime!

My partner has taken all the feedback about Horny Holiday into consideration and is working hard to update, improve, and expand the game. The version 3.3 is now in Beta, available on the new Beta branch in your steam client in English or Chinese. There will be a few more updates after this, but for now, we wanted to share with you the latest and get feedback before it moves to the production branch.

What's in this update?

[list]
[*] 319 new images featuring Jack & Eva
[*] 23 new animations
[*] 26 new audio files, with 4 music tracks and 22 new sound effects
[*] 1 hot new scene in the replay gallery
[*] 3,300 or so words of new story with professional translation into Chinese (other languages pending)
[*] The new update alters the timeline before Jack visits the party, so the new content is easily accessed toward the beginning of the game, you literally can't miss it.
[/list]

Once we get some feedback in the two professionally created languages, we'll move on to creating the machine translations into the other languages that are available in the game.

Thanks for reading, and we hope you enjoy.

Brosef & Partner

notes.title: Exciting News for Horny Holiday Fans: Jack's Story Continues in SPARK OF JOY!
notes.content:
Get ready for the next chapter in Jack's love story! SPARK OF JOY is the highly anticipated sequel to Horny Holiday, and it's packed with even more romance, humor, and drama. If you loved Jack and Joy's budding connection in Horny Holiday, you'll be hooked as their relationship takes an unexpected turn.

In SPARK OF JOY, a heartbreaking twist puts Jack's romance with Joy on hold, sending him on a journey of self-discovery. Along the way, Jack meets four intriguing women, each offering a different kind of temptation or escape. Will he stay true to his heart and find his way back to Joy, or will he be pulled in new, unexpected directions? The choice is yours.

What can you look forward to?

[list]
[*] Deeper relationships, complex choices – Your decisions will shape Jack’s path, with multiple endings, both good and bad.
[*] Expanded sandbox gameplay – Freely explore new environments, interact with the world, and discover hidden surprises.
[*] Even more immersive experience – With tons of new animations, 3D-rendered environments, minigames, and over-the-top music and sound effects, SPARK OF JOY delivers a richer, longer, more dynamic adventure.
[/list]

If you enjoyed Horny Holiday, you won’t want to miss the next step in Jack’s journey. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264300/Spark_of_Joy/]Add SPARK of Joy to your Wishlist now[/url], and get ready to explore love, desire, and everything in between!

notes.title: Bug fixes for latest v3 edition
notes.content: Fixed feeding Joy replay bug; fixed a bug that allowed unlimited Spark of Joy from the punch bag, multiple spelling, grammar, and some audio fixes as well.

notes.title: V3 Launches Today
notes.content:
Hey folks, Guess What?

The developer who brought you Horny Holiday V2 (not me, a member of my team) just finished the massive expansion to Horny Holiday, and wow, it's amazing. We've got *double* the story - yep, it went from slim bloke to big boss, with more than ten thousand words of brand new story, taking the total to just over twenty thousand words now in the game.

What else is new?
[list]
[*]700 plus brand new images in full HD
[*]A whole new sandbox to explore, which is the gym inside the holiday party where Jack & Joy meet
[*]15 plus new animations
[*]Over 70 new audio and music tracks
[*]A brand new beginning and a new epilogue, so it's worth playing through from the very beginning to the end
[*]Updates to the replay feature including the game overs, in case you want to revisit those
[*]Five new achievements to earn in game
[/list]

Go on, give it a whirl and experience Joy.

Cheers,
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: Version 2.0 Now has Ten Thousand Words of Story, 700+ Images, and More
notes.content:
Let's begin with saying this is version 2.0, and you'll need to start a save file from scratch, the achievements are all new, and about half the images have been replaced. There are another six hundred plus in addition to what was there, and the new game explores a full day of Jack's life.

The updated game description is as follows:
Horny Holiday is a short romantic comedy visual novel. It begins with Jack, still reeling from a breakup with his girlfriend, Becky. To cope, he indulges in a cathartic moment: deciding which of his ex’s belongings to set on fire. After this release, Jack receives an invitation to a holiday housewarming party hosted by a new couple down the street.

At the party, Jack mistakes Joy, a confident guest, for the hostess. Amused, Joy plays along and gives Jack a tour of the house. As they explore, they bond over shared interests like cooking, video games, art, and exercise. Depending on your choices, Jack might express his genuine interest in Joy, leading to a heartwarming moment where they look forward to exploring their connection amidst the festivities.

Horny Holiday features sandbox functionality, allowing players to freely explore the house and interact with the environment. Choices matter, leading to multiple endings, including good, bad, and game over scenarios. The game includes optional minigames and point-and-click interactions to immerse players in the rich, 3D-rendered environment. With over 150 audio tracks, more than 80 animations, and 700 images, the game provides a captivating and dynamic experience.

[list]
[*] Over 100 new audio tracks and sound effects
[*] Seven thousand words of new story, bringing the total word count to a little over 10000 words in this edition. 
[*] 14+ new animations, including fixes to existing bugs to ensure everything plays, and works, as intended.
[*] Sandbox exploration, as well as new point & click game mechanics, are a first for one of my games, and something I can't for you to enjoy.
[/list]

Based on play time, the new experience should be a fun filled hour of ups, downs, comedy, romance, a few optional bad endings, depending on your choices, and one very sweet happily ever after ending.

Thanks for tuning in;
Brosef Chungus

notes.title: Horny Holiday Version 2.0 Coming Soon
notes.content:
The remake is going well and I wanted to share what's coming here on Steam. Horny Holiday today is around 60% finished for dialogue / outline is finished and story notes for the remaining renders & animations, of which probably 80% are done.

[list]
[*] The prior game content from Jack & Joy walking home to end is largely going to be the same, with the exception of the voice product being removed for the remaining instances (aren't many, but some). The other audio products will remain, since those are of a higher quality & fit well.
[*] The new audio content, including music, other SFX, amounts to around 80 files so far, about double the previous game, and a lot more songs, audio, and other sound effects.
[*] Older saves will work for the content that's carried over, but naturally the new content which is the new 70% or so of the game, a game save won't work well and it'll be recommended to play again from scratch.
[*] Old version had roughly ~125 renders, excluding animations, new version will have roughly 500 or so, with 80% of those finished, as the current in progress version contains roughly 400 renders.
[/list]

Thanks for reading, and I can't wait to share the update with you next month. 

Stay Thirsty, 
Brosef Chungus
